# BEIR NFCorpus

*Generated by `scripts/gen_bench_pages.py` from the `oml-bench/1` results in `eval/bench/results/`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python scripts/gen_bench_pages.py`, and CI fails when this page differs from what it writes.*

Suite `beir-nfcorpus`, data `beir/nfcorpus/test (ir_datasets 0.6.3)`: 3,633 memories, 323 queries; a method marked sampled asked a seeded subset, named in its row. Measured 2026-11-04 on commit `4a8f5ba`; build release, host 8 vCPU / 15 GB, postgres 17.9.

[All suites](index.md)

## Latency

|---|---:|---:|---:|
| keyword-all | 484 | 531 | 562 |
| keyword-any | 647 | 1,115 | 1,157 |
| bm25 | 132 | 175 | 183 |
| bm25-trigram | 2,218 | 3,120 | 3,470 |
| reference-bm25s-k1-0.9-b-0.4 | offline | offline | offline |
| reference-bm25s-k1-1.2-b-0.75 | offline | offline | offline |

## Limits of this run

- Offline bm25s over the same memories (Lucene BM25, English stop words, Snowball stems), not a served path; One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only.
- One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only.
